newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Hongkong Bank FRCD raised to HK$3.5 bln.
newsitem.headline: Hongkong Bank FRCD raised to HK$3.5 bln.

text.p: Hongkong and Shanghai Banking Corp's five-year floating rate certificate of deposit issue has been increased to HK$3.5 billion from HK$2.0 billion, said arranger HSBC Markets.
This issue was off the bank's HK$15 billion CD programme.
The certificates were launched on January 8 and priced at par to float at 30 basis points over the one-month Hong Kong Interbank Offered Rate.
With fees, the all-in return for top-tier managers is 38 basis points.
Application has been made to the Hong Kong Monetary Authority to accept the issue as eligible for its Liquidity Adjustment Facility, or discount window.
Arranger and bookrunner HSBC Markets committed to HK$230 million.

Lead managers are BNP Hong Kong, China Development Finance Co (Hong Kong), DKB Asia and Hang Seng Bank, with HK$130 million each, and ABN AMRO Bank Hong Kong, Asahi Finance (Hong Kong), Banca Commerciale italiana, Bayerische Landesbank Hong Kong, Chase Manhattan Asia, Commerz (East Asia), Daiwa Securities (HK), Dao Heng Bank, Dresdner (South East Asia), Fuji International Finance (HK), Hang Lung Treasury, ING Bank, Jardine Fleming Bank, LTCB Asia, Mitsubishi Trust Finance (Asia), NatWest Markets, Nikko Securities Co (Asia), Nippon Credit International (HK), Paribas Asia, Rabobank Hong Kong, Sakura Finance Asia, SGZ-Bank, Societe Generale Asia, Sudwestdeutsche Landesbank Singapore, Tokyo-
Co-lead manager Sumitomo Finance (Asia) committed to HK$65 million.
Senior managers, with HK$43 million each, are Banca di Roma Hong Kong, China Construction Bank Hong Kong, Credito Italiano Hong Kong, Deutsche Morgan Grenfell and DG Bank.

Co-managers are First Pacific Bank, with HK$33 million, and Banco Central Hispanoamericano Hong Kong, Bank of N.T. Butterfield & Son, CARIPLO Hong Kong and Thai Farmers Bank Hong Kong, with HK$22 million each.
Signing is set for February 4. The payment date is February 12.
